study type: Cross-sectional study for risk factor identification
exposure: historical health data (history of urinary catheterization, history of Cesarean)
cohort: The study included 300 patients (133 men and 167 women) with an average age of 49 years, who underwent urinary catheterization between June and December 2019.
finding: The significant risk factors for Catheter Related Bladder Discomfort (CRBD) identified were a catheter caliber >= 18 Fr, absence of lubrication, laparotomy, age < 50 years, and a history of Cesarean section or urinary catheterization.
mod_finding: A history of Cesarean section was identified as a significant risk factor for Catheter Related Bladder Discomfort (CRBD).
